cards.example_en: Anxiety about exams is common.
cards.example_zh: 对考试的焦虑很常见。

cards.example_en: He has an appetite for hard puzzles.
cards.example_zh: 他对难题有胃口。

cards.example_en: Her approach to revision is slow and steady.
cards.example_zh: 她处理复习的途径是慢而稳。

cards.example_en: The child shows an aptitude for music.
cards.example_zh: 这孩子显露出音乐方面的天资。

cards.example_en: There was an argument about the score.
cards.example_zh: 有一场关于比分的争论。

cards.example_en: An argument with a friend can hurt.
cards.example_zh: 同一位朋友的争吵可能让人难受。

cards.example_en: The arrangement for the trip is ready.
cards.example_zh: 为这次出行做的安排已经就绪。

cards.example_en: As a matter of fact, I was in the lab.
cards.example_zh: 事实上，我当时在实验室。

cards.example_en: As far as I know, the lab is open.
cards.example_zh: 就我所知，实验室开着。

cards.example_en: I like rice. As for noodles, I can eat a little.
cards.example_zh: 我喜欢米饭。至于面条，我能吃一点。

cards.example_en: As to the date, we can decide tomorrow.
cards.example_zh: 关于日期这一点，我们可以明天再定。

cards.example_en: She speaks French as well as English.
cards.example_zh: 她会说法语，也会说英语。

cards.example_en: Her attachment to the old school is strong.
cards.example_zh: 她对母校的依恋很深。

cards.example_en: The first attempt at the poem failed.
cards.example_zh: 对这首诗的第一次尝试失败了。

cards.example_en: Attention to detail saved the experiment.
cards.example_zh: 对细节的关注挽救了实验。

cards.example_en: His attitude to failure is calm.
cards.example_zh: 他对失败的态度很平静。

cards.example_en: The attraction to the coast is obvious.
cards.example_zh: 对海岸的吸引力显而易见。

cards.example_en: Awareness of risk can prevent accidents.
cards.example_zh: 对风险的意识可以防止事故。

cards.example_en: We stayed in because of the storm.
cards.example_zh: 因为暴风雨，我们待在室内。

cards.example_en: Belief in effort keeps the team going.
cards.example_zh: 对努力的信念让队伍继续前进。

cards.example_en: A bias against new ideas slows a class.
cards.example_zh: 对新想法的偏见会拖慢一个班。

cards.example_en: Extra homework is a burden on weekends.
cards.example_zh: 额外作业是加在周末上的负担。

cards.example_en: She has a capacity for careful work.
cards.example_zh: 她有做细致工作的才能。

cards.example_en: The essay is a challenge to lazy habits.
cards.example_zh: 这篇文章是对懒惰习惯的挑战。

cards.example_en: The change from winter to spring is sudden.
cards.example_zh: 从冬天到春天的变化来得很突然。

cards.example_en: Please leave a comment on this draft.
cards.example_zh: 请在这篇草稿上留下评语。

cards.example_en: There is concern about the river level.
cards.example_zh: 人们对河流水位有忧虑。

cards.example_en: Concern for safety shaped the rule.
cards.example_zh: 对安全的关心促成了这条规则。

cards.example_en: Confidence in the plan grew after the trial.
cards.example_zh: 试验之后，对这项计划的信心增加了。

cards.example_en: Confusion about the map caused the delay.
cards.example_zh: 对地图的困惑造成了耽搁。

cards.example_en: The road is long. Even so, we continue.
cards.example_zh: 路还很长。即便如此，我们继续。

cards.example_en: Please focus on the labelled diagram.
cards.example_zh: 请把焦点放在那张带标注的图上。

cards.example_en: She took a glance at the station clock.
cards.example_zh: 她瞥了一眼车站的钟。

cards.example_en: In addition to English, she studies physics.
cards.example_zh: 除英语之外，她还学物理。

cards.example_en: In case of fire, use the stairs.
cards.example_zh: 如果发生火灾，走楼梯。

cards.example_en: In conclusion, the data support the claim.
cards.example_zh: 最后总之，数据支持这个说法。

cards.example_en: In general, buses here are on time.
cards.example_zh: 一般来说，这里的公交准时。

cards.example_en: They trained in spite of the rain.
cards.example_zh: 尽管下雨，他们还是训练。

cards.example_en: In terms of cost, the bus is cheaper.
cards.example_zh: 从费用方面来看，坐公交更便宜。

cards.example_en: In view of the fog, the trip was delayed.
cards.example_zh: 鉴于有雾，行程推迟了。

cards.example_en: Let us walk instead of taking a taxi.
cards.example_zh: 我们走路吧，而不是打车。

cards.example_en: A lack of sleep hurts attention.
cards.example_zh: 缺乏睡眠会伤害注意力。

cards.example_en: Needless to say, practice still matters.
cards.example_zh: 不必说，练习仍然重要。

cards.example_en: You may leave on condition that the form is done.
cards.example_zh: 你可以离开，以表格填完为条件。

cards.example_en: The match was paused owing to thunder.
cards.example_zh: 比赛暂停起因于打雷。

cards.example_en: Join the choir regardless of your score.
cards.example_zh: 不论分数如何，都可以加入合唱团。

cards.example_en: Thanks to your map, we did not get lost.
cards.example_zh: 多亏你的地图，我们没有迷路。
